encoding.description: Encoder output format version (encode::ENCODING). Accepted if >= site MIN_ENCODING for any valid non-dirty git commit. When omitted, encoder must appear in GET /api/encoders.

codebooks.description: Codebooks implemented by the encoder. Absent restricts claims to legacy uniform pmcgx [64,32,96] layers.

job_version.description: Highest job format version supported by the encoder (absent defaults to 1).

request.description: Client-generated idempotency token for retrying lost claim replies.

weights.description: Checkpoint weights_ids available to the encoder. Used to draw from any matching active job when neither job nor layer is specified.

cached.description: Layer affinity hint mapping weights_id to layer indices already cached locally.

job.description: Explicit target job name. Overrides weights-based job selection.

layer.description: Target layer index within job (or default_job when job is omitted).

expert.description: Target expert slot index (requires layer; incompatible with count > 1).

count.description: Request up to count compatible slots in a single batch. Presence of this field wraps the 201 reply in {"claims": [...]}.
